_readme: The bespoke flow on the homepage, plus an optional gallery of bespoke examples (artwork → finished piece). Add to `examples` and the gallery publishes itself.

steps.title: Your artwork
steps.text: Painting, drawing, CAD, scheme or reference. Whatever exists — including a rough idea and a floor plan.

steps.title: Our development
steps.text: Construction or technique, material, colour and scale. Strike-offs, samples and colour trials until it reads right.

steps.title: Your piece
steps.text: Made to your dimensions, checked against the approved sample, finished and packed in Delhi.
